id.title: Sinkronisasi rilis aplikasi v2.3
id.summary: Tim sepakat rilis v2.3 dimundurkan ke Jumat karena bug login di Android belum selesai. QA butuh dua hari untuk regression test setelah fix masuk. Marketing tetap menyiapkan materi launch, tapi jadwal posting digeser mengikuti tanggal rilis.
topics: Status bug login Android dan estimasi fix
decisions: Rilis v2.3 dimundurkan ke Jumat, 16 Oktober
Fitur dark mode ditunda ke v2.4

en.title: Version 2.3 release plan review
en.summary: The team moved the v2.3 release to Friday because the Android login bug is still open. QA needs two days of regression testing once the fix lands. Marketing keeps preparing launch material, with posting dates following the new release date.
topics: Android login bug status and fix estimate
decisions: Release v2.3 moves to Friday, October 16
Dark mode is deferred to v2.4

id.speaker: Peserta
id.text: Oke, kita mulai ya. Jadi update dari tim mobile gimana, Bud?

id.speaker: Peserta
id.text: Bug login di Android masih ada, root cause-nya udah ketemu, di token refresh. Fix-nya kira-kira selesai Rabu.

id.speaker: Saya
id.text: Berarti QA baru bisa mulai Kamis ya. Sari, regression test butuh berapa lama?

id.speaker: Peserta
id.text: Minimal dua hari kalau full. Jadi paling cepat rilis Jumat.

id.speaker: Saya
id.text: Oke, kita sepakat rilis mundur ke Jumat. Dark mode kita pindah ke v2.4 aja biar nggak nambah risiko.

id.speaker: Peserta
id.text: Siap. Dewi, nanti jadwal posting launch tolong disesuaikan ya.

en.speaker: Peserta
en.text: Okay, let's start. Budi, what's the update from the mobile team?

en.speaker: Peserta
en.text: The Android login bug is still open. We found the root cause in the token refresh, the fix should be done by Wednesday.

en.speaker: Saya
en.text: So QA can only start on Thursday. Sari, how long does a regression test take?

en.speaker: Peserta
en.text: At least two days for a full run, so Friday at the earliest.

en.speaker: Saya
en.text: Okay, we agree to move the release to Friday, and dark mode goes to v2.4 to keep the risk down.
